description: This PHP source file defines the class 'tlPlatform' responsible for handling platform-related operations in the TestLink project, such as creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving platform data from the database, as well as linking platforms to test plans and managing platform visibility and access.

classes.name: tlPlatform
classes.description: Class for handling platforms within the TestLink project, including CRUD operations, linkage management with test plans, and platform visibility and activation controls.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes database connection and sets the test project ID.

methods.name: setTestProjectID
methods.description: Sets the current test project ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new platform entry in the database.

methods.name: getByID
methods.description: Retrieves platform data by ID(s).

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Fetches platform data by its name within the current project.

methods.name: getPlatform
methods.description: Gets detailed information of a platform by ID (alias for getByID).

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates properties of an existing platform.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a platform from the database.

methods.name: linkToTestplan
methods.description: Links one or multiple platforms to a test plan.

methods.name: unlinkFromTestplan
methods.description: Removes linkage between platforms and a test plan.

methods.name: getID
methods.description: Retrieves platform ID by name.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches all platforms for the current project with optional linked count.

methods.name: getAllAsMap
methods.description: Retrieves all platforms as a map, with options to filter and order.

methods.name: platformsActiveForTestplan
methods.description: Checks if a test plan has linked platforms.

methods.name: getLinkedToTestplan
methods.description: Gets all platforms linked to a specific test plan in various formats.

methods.name: getLinkedToTestplanAsMap
methods.description: Gets linked platforms as a map with filtering options.

methods.name: throwIfEmptyName
methods.description: Validates that a platform name is not empty.

methods.name: deleteByTestProject
methods.description: Removes all platforms associated with a specific test project.

methods.name: testProjectCount
methods.description: Returns count of platforms per test project.

methods.name: belongsToTestProject
methods.description: Checks if a platform belongs to a specific test project.

methods.name: isLinkedToTestplan
methods.description: Checks if a platform is linked to a specific test plan.

methods.name: initViewGUI
methods.description: Prepares GUI view properties for platform management interface.

methods.name: enableDesign
methods.description: Enables the platform for design activity.

methods.name: disableDesign
methods.description: Disables the platform for design activity.

methods.name: enableExec
methods.description: Enables the platform for execution activity.

methods.name: disableExec
methods.description: Disables the platform for execution activity.

methods.name: openForExec
methods.description: Marks the platform as open for execution.

methods.name: closeForExec
methods.description: Marks the platform as closed for execution.

methods.name: getAsXMLString
methods.description: Generates an XML string representing platforms for a given project.
